description:
The trades a person's strategies have closed -- what was made or lost on each, why it exited, and what the fees and slippage cost. For a platform account overview and last-trade times use list_platform_strategies; platform detail requires strategy_id. Use this for what actually happened: 'how am I doing', 'what did it trade', 'why did it sell', 'has it made money'. Pass strategy_id for one strategy's record. THESE ARE REAL TRADES, not a backtest -- never mix them with backtest metrics in one number, and say which you are quoting. Every trade carries fee_cost, slippage_cost and gas_cost; a profit or loss quoted without them reads as though trading were free. Passing strategy_id takes precedence -- asset and outcome are not applied alongside it.

[Access: pay 0.001 USDC via x402 (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header) OR authenticate with an API key. An x402-capable client will auto-pay; API-key clients pay nothing per call.]

asset.description: Asset symbol, e.g. BTC or ETH.
